# DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE - edit the master and reinstall.
# (/tmp/crontab.aBc123 installed on Mon Aug 31 22:34:51 2026)
# (Cron version -- $FreeBSD$)
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
MAILTO=""
HOME=/home/operator

# Rotate the logs before anyone is awake
30	4	*	*	*	/usr/local/sbin/rotate-logs --quiet
@weekly /usr/local/sbin/prune-archives
0,30 * * * * /usr/local/bin/heartbeat >/dev/null 2>&1

# OpenBSD randomizes its own maintenance windows with ~ ranges, and
# writes them into the stock root crontab
30~45	1	*	*	*	/bin/sh /etc/daily
~	2	*	*	6	/bin/sh /etc/weekly

# FreeBSD names two schedules of its own
@every_minute /usr/local/bin/poll-sensor
@every_second /usr/local/bin/tick
